lines.text: The Israelites settled in Goshen, and Jacob lived in Egypt seventeen years.
Jacob made Joseph swear to bury him with his fathers, and Israel bowed in worship at his bed.
Jacob said God Almighty appeared to him at Bethel, and that Ephraim and Manasseh would be his.
Jacob said Rachel died on the way from Paddan and he buried her beside the road to Hebron.
Israel crossed his hands and put his right hand on Ephraim, the younger, although Manasseh was the firstborn.
